title: BlisterB
tagline: This project is for sneaker lovers and creators. Support and create a sneaker project using blockchain.
description: This project is for sneaker lovers and creators. We can see that people have many ideas related to sneakers but they don't have enough funds to make their dream possible but in this project you can create and support a sneaker project and this will help to raise funding or contribute to any sneaker project you like.
how_its_made: This project is made on Solidity and @Neon EVM (We used Neon ECM because of low gas fee and this is very useful in the project) which uses the lighthouse.storage to store images. you can create and support a sneaker project and this will help to raise funding or contribute to any sneaker project you like.
